# Frayme SDK

> Frayme is the last-mile generative-UI layer for agents: POST a natural-language prompt to api.frayme.ai/v1/compose and get back a validated json-render UI spec, streamed as typed SSE. The SDK is three MIT npm packages: @frayme/api (typed client + agent tool), @frayme/catalog (the 189-component vocabulary + spec validation), and @frayme/runtime (React renderer + Vercel AI SDK and AG-UI transport adapters).

Key facts for integrating:
- Install: `npm i @frayme/api @frayme/runtime` (server: `new Frayme({apiKey})`; browser: keyless proxy mode `new Frayme({apiKey: null, baseURL: '/api/your-proxy'})` — never put fr_live_ keys in a browser).
- Streaming events: compose.started → op×N (live, provisional) → [compose.restarted ⇒ DISCARD rendered state] → compose.completed (final, validated) | error (typed FraymeError, retryable with idempotent replay).
- One agent-tool definition serves all frameworks: `import { composeToolDefinition, createComposeTool } from '@frayme/api/tools'` — works with Vercel AI SDK 6 (inputSchema), Mastra (inputSchema), OpenAI Agents JS (parameters), LangChain.js (schema). The schema is Zod v4 / Standard Schema.
- Render: `<FraymeRenderer spec={spec} onDynamicAction={...}/>` from '@frayme/runtime/react' + import '@frayme/runtime/styles.css'. Most interactions (state, tabs, typing) resolve locally with zero round-trip; spec-bound named actions reach onDynamicAction.
- AI SDK chat apps: server bridges with composeStreamToDataParts() (from '@frayme/runtime'); client renders with <FraymeMessageRenderer message={message}/> (from '@frayme/runtime/ai-sdk').
- AG-UI agents (LangGraph, CrewAI, Mastra, Pydantic AI…): deliver the spec as a CUSTOM 'frayme:spec' event; client uses useFraymeAgUiSpec() + <FraymeAgUiRenderer/> (from '@frayme/runtime/ag-ui'); dynamic actions register as the 'frayme:action' frontend tool.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.frayme.ai): guides, component reference, and the full API wire contract (including the SSE event union) for non-TypeScript integrations
- [SDK repo](https://github.com/frayme-ai/frayme-sdk): source for all three packages
- [Website](https://frayme.ai): get an API key
